title: Tag and category taxonomy with a validity gate
question: Define a controlled category vocabulary plus a free-tag policy with a validity gate (normalised casing, length bound, no near-duplicate of an existing tag above a similarity threshold), so the tag space does not fragment into synonyms that break discovery.
answer: tools/marketplace/tag_gate.py admits free tags only after NFKC/lowercase normalize, charset and length checks, separator-compact duplicate detection, and difflib.SequenceMatcher.ratio against the live set. The similarity threshold is the declared parameter 0.85 in tools/marketplace/tag_gate_params.json, not a literal in the gate module. Categories are a closed vocabulary in categories.json. reverse_engineering is refused against live reverse-engineering; sbom-attestation is accepted as new. All 7 live plugin.json keywords pass the sweep, so the threshold is enforced rather than reported-wrong.

signal_2.claim: a sweep over the CURRENT keyword set confirms every existing tag passes — if a live tag fails, the threshold is wrong and must be reported rather than enforced

evidence.notes: Signal 1 is a planted near-duplicate versus a planted new tag. Signal 2 is the live keyword census. They are not the same check.

negative_controls.description: All 7 existing keywords in .claude-plugin/plugin.json must be accepted. A failure means the threshold is wrong.
sbom-attestation is accepted as new in the same run that refuses reverse_engineering as a near-duplicate.

reviewer.requirement: Reviewer must propose two tags that should be distinct but collide under the threshold, and report the false-merge rate.
reviewer.notes: 'parse' (action) and 'parser' (component) should stay distinct under this policy but SequenceMatcher.ratio is above the declared threshold 0.85. On the 8-pair inflection fixture the false-merge rate is 0.625 (5/8). Stemming is out of scope; the residual is disclosed rather than tuned away.
